version_derivation.rule: SEMVER derived from commit history, not chosen by hand.
version_derivation.basis: The history contains one feat commit (`feat(m0): add compiling workspace with enforced secretless boundaries`) plus fixes and docs. A new public capability is a MINOR; the fixes are PATCH-level and do not force a MAJOR.

uat_threat_harness_runs_with_no_connecto.evidence: Five ATTACK_* scripts run against real asv-brokerd and asv processes. crates/ contains broker, cli, domain, identity and ipc-protocol only: zero connector crates exist, which is the condition the roadmap names.

debt_carried.composition: 3 P0 gate-map defects, 2 P1 ungated UATs
debt_carried.handling: Registered as triaged SDDK backlog items. The signed spec pack is normative and was not patched; tools/check-gates.py reports them instead.
debt_carried.why_not_patched: Editing a signed, normative pack to make a gate check pass would be the exact class of shortcut this project exists to reject.

known_limitations_shipped: No vault. M0 verifies boundary properties, not protection of stored secret material.
Same-uid processes can read broker memory. A dedicated broker uid is M7.
argv is readable by every same-uid process. No ASV change affects this; the M0 CLI has no credential-ingestion command.

external_reproduction.detail: Cloned from the published remote into an empty directory with its own target dir. 35 tests, clippy 0 under -D warnings, fmt clean, harness 11/11, falsification 3/3, spec pack 37/37. Source tree byte-identical to local.
